description: Runs a read-only SPARQL query on Wikidata and returns the rows as plain values (ASK returns true or false). Only SELECT and ASK are allowed; updates are refused. A LIMIT of 100 or less is added when missing. 8-second limit. Data is CC0. Choose this tool for: Read Wikidata with a read-only SPARQL query. Close alternatives on this server: sql_generate (Generate a read-only SQL query from a question and a schema). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

query.description: A SPARQL SELECT or ASK query, up to 4,000 characters
